card.name: Dashes in table separator rows
card.fires_on: Repeated ' ---' dash separators inside plain-text tables, mainly the dash cells in the middle of a row. Also fires weakly on a few word-internal pieces and on 'and' after a drug list.

modes.label: Table dash cells
modes.description: The ' ---' marker repeated in a row of dashes in a text table of numbers.

modes.label: Partway through words
modes.description: Middle pieces of longer words such as 'Durations', 'cucumbers' and 'constituted'.
modes.example: Dur<<ations>> for ZEPATIER for Treatment of

modes.label: And after opioid mention
modes.description: The word 'and' just before 'other opioids' in a risk statement.
modes.example: ],<< and>> other opioids). Because of these risks,
